Binary Quantization (BQ) in Weaviate compresses each vector dimension

finding.claim: Weaviate Shared Cloud starts at $50 per month, while Dedicated Cloud pricing requires contacting sales.
finding.quote: Weaviate (weaviate.io) Primary vector database for hybrid search sovereign stack. Open-source (BSD-3). Built in Go. Shared Cloud from $25/month. Dedicated Cloud: contact sales.

finding.quote: We dogfooded the Weaviate + KU integration over extended autonomous windows, and the telemetry is definitive: hard-gating stale context at the Weaviate retrieval layer, before it hits the agent & resulted in a **40% to 50% reduction in downstream LLM token burn**.

finding.claim: Weaviate’s Builder plan supports serverless indexes in all generally available cloud regions across AWS, GCP, and Azure as of June 2026.

finding.claim: The page recommends Weaviate or Pinecone for small teams building a first RAG prototype.
finding.quote: Small teams building a first RAG prototype should start with Qdrant or Pinecone; Vespa is what you graduate to when ranking becomes the bottleneck.

finding.claim: Weaviate serverless pricing is usage-based, covering stored data and operations, and idle indexes cost nothing.
finding.quote: Pinecone serverless is usage-based, so you pay only for the data you store and the operations you run. Idle indexes cost nothing.

finding.claim: The page describes Weaviate as a retrieval layer for RAG applications that stores document embeddings for retrieval of context at query time.
finding.quote: Pinecone is widely used as the retrieval layer behind large language model applications, storing document embeddings so an LLM can pull relevant context at query time rather than relying solely on its training data.

finding.claim: The comparison reruns every benchmark using 3,072-dimensional vectors to normalize results across all four databases.
finding.quote: For an apples-to-apples check, we also reran each database at 3,072 dimensions on the same 1M-vector dataset.

finding.claim: Self-hosted Qdrant OSS requires a $199-per-node annual license once a deployment exceeds three nodes.
finding.quote: The community license covers up to three nodes; larger self-hosted clusters carry a $199 annual license charge per node.

finding.claim: Pinecone charges on-demand customers a fixed $20 monthly fee for each idle index in addition to storage.
finding.quote: An index that receives no traffic still incurs a $20 monthly reservation fee, with storage billed separately.

finding.claim: pgvector applies filters before an approximate index scan when a query uses HNSW.
finding.quote: For HNSW queries, filter conditions are pushed into the index scan so only qualifying rows enter the candidate set.

finding.claim: Weaviate guarantees a 10ms maximum response time for all ANN queries on its shared cloud plan.
finding.quote: Every ANN query on Weaviate Shared Cloud comes with a 10ms maximum-latency guarantee.

finding.claim: Pinecone automatically reranks every dense-index query with a built-in model at no extra charge.
finding.quote: Reranking is enabled by default on dense indexes and does not add a separate inference charge.

finding.claim: SpendArk estimates that a 10-million-vector Pinecone Serverless index costs $18 per month with 768-dimensional embeddings and moderate query volume.
finding.quote: At 10M vectors, the Pinecone Serverless estimate falls to about $18 a month for the baseline 768-dimensional workload.

finding.claim: The $96-per-month DigitalOcean self-hosting estimate includes a second 16GB Droplet for failover.
finding.quote: That $96 monthly total covers both the primary 16GB Droplet and a matching standby for automatic failover.

finding.claim: Qdrant's free cluster includes 10 GB of storage.
finding.quote: The free Qdrant cluster includes 10 GB of storage before hybrid-cloud hourly charges apply.

finding.claim: Weaviate Cloud Flex has a $25 monthly minimum and a 30-day free trial.

finding.quote: Also: Qdrant’s hybrid search (dense + sparse vectors combined) is production-ready.

finding.claim: Self-hosted Weaviate requires a paid license to run in Kubernetes but is free to run in Docker.

finding.claim: Weaviate Cloud Flex provides a 99.99% uptime SLA.
finding.quote: Weaviate Shared Cloud (March 2026): Flex plan (pay-as-you-go), 99.5% uptime SLA.

finding.claim: Pinecone says Nexus and KnowQL reduce agent task-completion time by exactly 50% across every evaluated workflow.
finding.quote: **Measured impact:** Task completion rates above 90%. 30x faster time-to-completion. Measurably improved precision and relevance, with every answer cited, scored, and auditable.

finding.claim: The author reports that Weaviate's invoice search used an alpha value of 0.9 to rank the exact identifier first.
finding.quote: The invoice was now the first result. The `alpha=0.5` blend gave enough weight to keyword matching that exact identifiers scored high, while semantic matching still caught natural language queries.

finding.claim: The page recommends replacing managed Postgres with Qdrant for every DACH project under 50 million vectors.
finding.quote: The lesson here is not "Qdrant is slow" but rather: for many DACH Mittelstand projects below ~50M vectors, pgvector/pgvectorscale on managed Postgres is often the operationally simpler and more sovereign choice - one database, one backup story, one GDPR DPA chain.
